events.headlineId: Bank Sentral Virtual Pertahankan Suku Bunga Acuan, Beri Sinyal Waspada Inflasi
events.headlineEn: Virtual Central Bank Holds Benchmark Rate Steady While Flagging Inflation Watch
events.summaryId: Komite kebijakan moneter menahan suku bunga pada level saat ini, tetapi membuka opsi pengetatan lanjutan jika tekanan biaya energi bertahan dalam beberapa siklus mendatang.
events.summaryEn: Monetary policymakers kept benchmark rates unchanged but left the door open to further tightening if energy cost pressures persist over upcoming cycles.
events.bullCaseId: Stabilitas suku bunga memberi ruang napas bagi sektor pertumbuhan dan likuiditas pasar untuk pulih bertahap.
events.bullCaseEn: Rate stability gives growth sectors and market liquidity room to stabilize gradually.
events.bearCaseId: Nada hati-hati soal inflasi menandakan biaya pendanaan berisiko tetap tinggi lebih lama dari perkiraan pasar.
events.bearCaseEn: Cautious inflation language signals borrowing costs could stay elevated longer than consensus expects.

events.headlineId: Nusantara Komputasi Umumkan Ekspansi Pusat Data Besar-Besaran
events.headlineEn: Nusantara Komputasi Unveils Major Regional Data-Center Expansion Plan
events.summaryId: Manajemen NSKP meningkatkan anggaran belanja modal tahun ini untuk membangun klaster komputasi baru, bersamaan dengan laporan pertumbuhan pendapatan berulang kuartalan.
events.summaryEn: NSKP management raised annual capital expenditure guidance to build new compute clusters alongside steady quarterly recurring revenue growth.
events.bullCaseId: Kapasitas baru dapat mempercepat kontrak korporasi jangka panjang dan memperkuat pangsa pasar komputasi.
events.bullCaseEn: Expanded capacity could accelerate long-term enterprise contracts and widen competitive moat.
events.bearCaseId: Lonjakan belanja modal berpotensi menekan arus kas bebas serta margin laba jangka pendek.
events.bearCaseEn: Heavy upfront capital spending may compress near-term free cash flow and operating margins.

events.headlineId: Regulator Terapkan Uji Ketahanan Cadangan Kredit Baru untuk Sektor Perbankan
events.headlineEn: Regulator Introduces Stricter Credit-Buffer Stress Tests Across Banking Sector
events.summaryId: Otoritas keuangan meminta bank besar meninjau ulang rasio pencadangan kredit produktif guna mengantisipasi perlambatan siklikal di sektor riil.
events.summaryEn: Financial supervisors asked major lenders to review loan-loss provisioning ratios ahead of potential cyclical slowdowns in commercial credit.
events.bullCaseId: Pengetatan standar justru memperkuat kepercayaan deposan dan ketahanan neraca perbankan jangka panjang.
events.bullCaseEn: Tighter buffers bolster depositor confidence and strengthen long-term bank balance sheets.
events.bearCaseId: Kewajiban pencadangan lebih tinggi berisiko menahan penyaluran kredit baru dan ekspansi laba bersih.
events.bearCaseEn: Higher reserve requirements could slow fresh loan growth and trim near-term net earnings.

events.headlineId: Biaya Distribusi Pangan Berfluktuasi di Tengah Pergeseran Musim Panen
events.headlineEn: Food Distribution Costs Fluctuate Amid Shifting Regional Harvest Windows
events.summaryId: PSRY melaporkan kenaikan tarif logistik antarpulau selama dua pekan terakhir, sementara permintaan ritel kebutuhan pokok tetap stabil.
events.summaryEn: PSRY reported higher inter-island freight costs over the past two weeks even as core retail staple demand remained resilient.
events.bullCaseId: Permintaan pangan inelastis memungkinkan perusahaan meneruskan sebagian biaya tanpa kehilangan volume.
events.bullCaseEn: Inelastic staple demand may allow gradual price pass-through without losing customer volume.
events.bearCaseId: Kenaikan ongkos angkut berpotensi menggerus margin kotor jika penyesuaian harga tertunda.
events.bearCaseEn: Rising freight costs could squeeze gross margins if retail price adjustments lag.

events.headlineId: Rancangan Insentif Transmisi Energi Terbarukan Masuk Tahap Pembahasan Akhir
events.headlineEn: Draft Renewable Grid-Access Incentive Enters Final Policy Deliberation
events.summaryId: Skema tarif baru untuk pembangkit surya skala utilitas masih diperdebatkan terkait porsi subsidi investasi awal dan batas kapasitas penyerapan jaringan.
events.summaryEn: Proposed tariff structures for utility-scale solar face active debate over upfront investment credits and grid-absorption caps.
events.bullCaseId: Kepastian tarif berpeluang mempercepat realisasi proyek pipa SDKT yang selama ini tertunda.
events.bullCaseEn: Tariff clarity could unlock SDKT's delayed utility-scale project backlog.
events.bearCaseId: Ketentuan batas kapasitas dalam draf final berpotensi membatasi potensi pendapatan puncak.
events.bearCaseEn: Proposed capacity caps in the final text might limit peak revenue upside.

events.headlineId: Pembaruan Protokol GarudaChain Tingkatkan Throughput, Sebagian Validator Minta Jeda Uji
events.headlineEn: GarudaChain Protocol Upgrade Boosts Throughput as Some Validators Urge Extended Testing
events.summaryId: Rilis kandidat v4.2 menawarkan pemrosesan blok dua kali lebih cepat, namun beberapa operator node besar meminta waktu verifikasi tambahan sebelum aktivasi penuh.
events.summaryEn: Release candidate v4.2 promises doubled block throughput, though several major node operators requested extended verification before full activation.
events.bullCaseId: Adopsi pembaruan yang mulus dapat menarik pengembang dApp baru dan menaikkan utilitas jaringan.
events.bullCaseEn: Smooth upgrade rollout could attract fresh dApp builders and increase on-chain utility.
events.bearCaseId: Perbedaan sikap antar-validator dapat menunda aktivasi atau memicu volatilitas sementara di pasar.
events.bearCaseEn: Validator disagreement risks rollout delays and heightened short-term market turbulence.

events.headlineId: Audit Independen Temukan Celah Konfigurasi pada Jembatan Likuiditas DeFi
events.headlineEn: Independent Audit Flags Configuration Anomaly in DeFi Cross-Chain Liquidity Bridge
events.summaryId: Tim keamanan protokol segera membekukan sementara modul jembatan setelah temuan audit rutin; tidak ada laporan kehilangan dana, tetapi penarikan sempat melambat.
events.summaryEn: Protocol security teams paused bridge routing after a routine audit finding; no user loss was confirmed, though withdrawal queues briefly lengthened.
events.bullCaseId: Deteksi dini sebelum eksploitasi menunjukkan prosedur keamanan berjalan dan dana inti tetap aman.
events.bullCaseEn: Proactive detection prior to any exploit shows security controls work and core pools remain intact.
events.bearCaseId: Jeda penarikan sementara berpotensi memicu perpindahan likuiditas keluar dari token utilitas.
events.bearCaseEn: Temporary withdrawal throttling can trigger liquidity flight across smaller DeFi tokens.

events.headlineId: Cadangan Logam Mulia Institusional Naik saat Imbal Hasil Riil Bergerak Tak Menentu
events.headlineEn: Institutional Precious-Metal Reserves Rise Amid Uncertain Real-Yield Swings
events.summaryId: Laporan mingguan menunjukkan akumulasi bertahap kontrak emas virtual oleh manajer cadangan, meski penguatan mata uang cadangan membatasi laju reli.
events.summaryEn: Weekly reserve disclosures show steady accumulation of virtual gold contracts even as reserve-currency firmness caps sharp breakouts.
events.bullCaseId: Permintaan lindung nilai dari institusi sering menopang harga komoditas logam mulia saat ketidakpastian naik.
events.bullCaseEn: Institutional hedging demand often supports precious metals when macro uncertainty rises.
events.bearCaseId: Kenaikan imbal hasil obligasi virtual dapat membuat aset tanpa bunga seperti emas kehilangan daya tarik.
events.bearCaseEn: Rebounding virtual bond yields could reduce the appeal of non-yielding safe-haven assets.

events.headlineId: Antrean Tanker di Selat Utama Picu Spekulasi Pasokan Energi Jangka Pendek
events.headlineEn: Tanker Congestion in Key Maritime Strait Sparks Short-Term Energy Supply Debate
events.summaryId: Gangguan cuaca di jalur pelayaran energi memperlambat jadwal bongkar muat selama 72 jam, sementara stok strategis wilayah utama masih berada di rata-rata 5 tahun.
events.summaryEn: Weather disruptions slowed crude tanker turnaround for 72 hours, though regional strategic inventories remain near their five-year average.
events.bullCaseId: Hambatan pengiriman dapat memperketat pasokan spot dan mendorong premi harga energi jangka pendek.
events.bullCaseEn: Shipping bottlenecks may tighten near-term spot availability and support energy premiums.
events.bearCaseId: Stok strategis yang memadai dan melemahnya permintaan manufaktur dapat meredam lonjakan harga.
events.bearCaseEn: Ample strategic buffers and softer industrial demand could quickly cap any temporary price spike.

events.headlineId: Surplus Neraca Dagang Menyempit, Aliran Modal Valuta Asing Terpecah
events.headlineEn: Trade Surplus Narrows as Cross-Border Currency Flows Diverge
events.summaryId: Data ekspor-impor kuartalan mencatat kenaikan impor bahan baku industri melebihi ekspektasi, memicu penyesuaian posisi antar pelaku pasar valas.
events.summaryEn: Quarterly trade figures showed industrial raw-material imports exceeding consensus, prompting currency-desk rebalancing.
events.bullCaseId: Kenaikan impor bahan baku kerap menjadi sinyal awal ekspansi produksi industri domestik.
events.bullCaseEn: Higher raw-material imports often precede domestic industrial output expansion.
events.bearCaseId: Penyempitan surplus dagang berpotensi melemahkan dukungan neraca transaksi berjalan terhadap mata uang lokal.
events.bearCaseEn: A narrower trade surplus can weaken current-account support for the domestic virtual currency.

events.headlineId: Tinjauan Berkala Bobot IKN30 Jadwalkan Penyesuaian Alokasi Sektor Teknologi & Bank
events.headlineEn: IKN30 Periodic Weight Review Schedules Technology and Banking Reallocation
events.summaryId: Komite indeks mengumumkan rotasi bobot konstituen kuartalan yang akan berlaku efektif pada sesi pembukaan siklus berikutnya.
events.summaryEn: The index committee announced its quarterly constituent weight rotation taking effect at the upcoming cycle open.
events.bullCaseId: Arus penyesuaian dana pasif dapat meningkatkan likuiditas dan minat beli di saham berkapitalisasi besar.
events.bullCaseEn: Passive fund rebalancing flows can boost liquidity and demand across index heavyweights.
events.bearCaseId: Penyeimbangan ulang sering memicu fluktuasi sementara saat dana institusional melepas bobot lama.
events.bearCaseEn: Index rebalancing often creates temporary churn as institutional funds trim outgoing weights.

events.headlineId: Rumor Konsolidasi Infrastruktur AI Lokal Beredar di Kalangan Analis Teknologi
events.headlineEn: Unconfirmed Local AI-Infrastructure Consolidation Rumors Circulate Among Tech Analysts
events.summaryId: Sumber industri menyebut adanya pembicaraan awal kemitraan lisensi chip dan komputasi awan, namun belum ada pernyataan resmi dari perusahaan terkait.
events.summaryEn: Industry chatter points to early licensing and cloud-capacity talks, though no listed firm has issued formal confirmation.
events.bullCaseId: Sinergi infrastruktur dapat menurunkan biaya komputasi per unit dan mempercepat peluncuran produk.
events.bullCaseEn: Shared infrastructure could lower unit compute costs and speed up commercial rollouts.
events.bearCaseId: Rumor yang belum terkonfirmasi kerap berbalik cepat jika negosiasi tidak menghasilkan kesepakatan.
events.bearCaseEn: Unconfirmed market rumors frequently unwind sharply if talks fail to materialize.
